Kept as a documented digit-legibility failure case (6 vs 0 in dot-matrix thermal print) rather than silently corrected away — see failure taxonomy.

The source dataset's own annotation says 2016-04-03, which this reviewer's direct read disagrees with; the printed digits are unambiguous ('06/04/2016'), so the dataset annotation is treated as wrong here. This is a genuinely non-PH, DD/MM receipt useful for confirming the parser's PH-convention default reads it correctly by coincidence of convention match, not as evidence either way for a true MM/DD receipt.
